Mainly using SPSS 26.0 and AMOS 22.0 software, conducting variance tests, common method bias tests, and subject object interdependence tests to analyze the expression mechanism of unstable emotions between partners. Result: (1) The results of the one-way maximum variance test showed that the maximum factor loading rate of the scales for gaming addiction, inner fear, and unsafe attachment emotions was 19.24%, which is less than the 40% threshold, and there is no serious problem of common method bias.(2) There is a significant positive correlation between unsafe attachment, inner fear, and addiction to esports games among college students, with an r coefficient ranging from 0.24 to 0.60.(3) After bootstrap repeated sampling 5000 times, it was found that male college students with addiction to esports games can affect the generation of unsafe attachment emotions, indirectly affect the inner fear of female partners, and lead to the expression of unstable emotions. This main effect is established.(4) In the pathway of expressing fear of missing out, the addiction of male partners to esports games directly affects the inner fear of female partners, indirectly forming unstable emotional expression of female partners, leading to unsafe attachment emotions. This object benefit exists, and the model fitting index meets the standard (△ x 2 (4)=0.552, P =0.907, RMSEA=0.037, SRMR=0.024, GFI=0.902). Conversely, the expression pathway of female influence on male college students does not hold true. Conclusion: When both men and women are addicted to e-sports games, the expression of insecurity attachment will be directly triggered. The fear of loss of male partners mediates the expression of insecurity attachment in women. MHBM309: ASSESSMENT AND PREDICTION OF THE NUTRITIONAL INDEX IN SEPTIC PATIENTS: A PROPENSITY SCORE-MATCHED ANALYSIS Qiang Liu a , Wei Wang b , Jie Zhang a , Chen Wu c a Department of Emergency, Air Force Hospital of Eastern Theater Command, Nanjing 210016, China, b Department of Ultrasound, West China Hospital of Sichuan University, Chengdu 610041, China, c Department of Emergency Medicine, The Second Hospital of Tianjin Medical University, Tianjin 300211, China. QL and WW contributed equally to this work. Objectives: The nutritional status scores of sepsis patients are not available. Triglycerides total cholesterol body weight index (TCBI) as a new nutritional index, includes three parameters, which are related to inflammation and prognosis of sepsis patients. We aimed to explore the association of TCBI with sepsis. Patients and Methods: We collected information on 877 patients from the MIMIC-III database. According to the median TCBI of 1198, it was divided into two groups, namely the low-value group(n=438,49.94%) and the high-value group(n=439,50.06%). Propensity score matching (PSM) was used to eliminate the bias caused by baseline characteristics between the low-value group (TCBI&lt;1198) and the high-value group (TCBI≥1198). We estimated the trend of TCBI value and mortality by the restricted cubic spline. We examined the survival time changes between different TCBI groups via the Kaplan–Meier(KM) method. We use a log-rank test to evaluate statistical significance. The Cox regression model explored the hazard ratio after PSM. Results: In the unmatched cohort comparison, the 28-day mortality (24.43%vs13.67%), 90-day mortality (33.56%vs19.82%), and one-year mortality (46.12%vs29.61%) in the low-value group were higher than those in the high-value group (p &lt; 0.001). The KM survival curve also showed that the survival curve of patients in the low-value group was lower than that in the high value group, and the death risk was higher than that in the high-value group (p &lt; 0.05). After adjusting for baseline characteristic deviations in age, weight, diabetes, and SAPSII scores, the low group had 28-day mortality (23.88%vs15.57%),90-day mortality (31.49%vs22.15%), one-year mortality rate (42.56%vs33.22%) was still higher than that of the high value group (p &lt; 0.05). The results of the KM survival curve are also consistent with those of the unmatched queue. The multiple Cox proportional hazards regression model included all potential risk factors after propensity score matching. The 28-day hazard ratio was more evident among the three outcomes with mortality risk, and the hazard ratio was 1.668 (1.132 - 2.457). In this model, the high TCBI group was always considered as the control group(p &lt; 0.05). Conclusions: The lower TCBI group went with the higher mortality hazard in the short and long term. There was no statistical significance in different TCBI groups about the length of stays in the ICU. (Project number: 2023XJZX04) MHBM312: THE EFFECTIVENESS STUDY OF THE CHAIN GREEN CHANNEL NURSING MODEL IN ISCHEMIC STROKE PATIENTS UNDERGOING INTRAVENOUS THROMBOLYSIS Yanzhuo Li a , Yajuan Liu a , Dan Liu a , Qi Li a , Shengnan Huang a , Junjie Wang a a Emergency Department, Daxing District People’s Hospital, Beijing 102699, China Background: Analyze the effects of implementing a chain-like green channel nursing model for emergency department thrombolytic therapy in patients with acute ischemic stroke. The chain management process takes individual links as management objects, connecting each internal horizontal and vertical management link to ensure the effectiveness and continuity of treatment. However, the current application of the chain management process is not yet mature in China. Therefore, this study aims to analyze the impact of the chain management process on the time limits and workflow connections at various nodes in emergency thrombolytic therapy for stroke patients. Subjects and Methods: A study was conducted on 186 cases of acute ischemic stroke patients who received alteplase intravenous thrombolysis at the emergency department of Daxing District People’s Hospital between March and September 2022. The study used a cluster sampling method and was conducted retrospectively. From March to September 2023, the emergency department of Daxing District People’s Hospital implemented the chain-like green channel nursing model for 354 cases of acute stroke patients who received intravenous thrombolysis. The model was chosen using a convenience sampling method. A comparison was made between the pre and post-application periods regarding Door-to-Needle Time (DNT) at various time intervals, NIHSS scores before and after thrombolysis, ADL scores, and other indicators to evaluate the effectiveness of the chain-like green channel nursing model. Results: A retrospective analysis of clinical data from ischemic stroke patients receiving intravenous thrombolysis in our hospital showed that the chain-like green channel nursing model effectively improved patient treatment outcomes, reduced the occurrence of complications, and enhanced the quality of life. The establishment of the integrated first-aid team and chain process nursing mode has made the nurses’ work orderly, and the cooperation among team members is more tacit, which greatly improved the timeliness of rescue. In the actual rescue work, the rapid response of nurses and the tacit cooperation and coordination between rescuers are particularly important. It is necessary to practice first-aid techniques regularly according to the standard, strengthen the training of the connection of various technologies and the coordination of personnel positioning, and repeatedly carry out decomposition exercises, overall simulation training and on-the-spot assessment of various first-aid techniques, and constantly revise the process to make the process more rational and efficient. Conclusions: The application of the chain-like green channel nursing model in patients with ischemic stroke receiving intravenous thrombolysis shows significant effectiveness and is worthy of clinical promotion. MHBM313: RETINAL ARTERY OCCLUSION AFTER SCLERAL BUCKLING SURGERY Wenjuan Lv a , Tongtong Niu a , Leibing Ji a , Yun Xiao a a Ophthalmology Department, Xinjiang 474 Hospital, Urumqi 830011, China. Background: Rhegmatogenous retinal detachment (RRD) is the most common type of retinal detachment in ophthalmology, which occurs on the basis of retinal tears. Liquefied vitreous bodies enter the sensory layer of the retinal nerve through the retinal tears, leading to retinal detachment. RRD can occur at any age, and the key to successful treatment of RRD is to accurately locate and seal the retinal tear, typically using pars plana vitrectomy (PPV) and scleral buckling (SB). The scleral buckling surgery is simple and efficient, mainly used for patients with simple retinal detachment caused by holes located in the peripheral retina. The surgery is divided into scleral ring ligation combined with external scleral compression and simple external scleral compression. Scleral buckling surgery is an extraocular surgery, and postoperative complications such as intraocular infection, cataracts, retinal incarceration, and iatrogenic tears will not occur. However, scleral buckling surgery can also bring some related postoperative complications, such as increased corneal curvature, muscle adhesion fibrosis causing restricted eye movement, posterior segment ischemia caused by implant material compression, and implant material exposure. These postoperative complications of scleral buckling surgery have been reported in previous literature, but retinal artery occlusion after scleral buckling surgery is rare. Subjects and Methods: We reported a young patient with rhegmatogenous retinal detachment who developed retinal artery occlusion after undergoing scleral buckling surgery. The patient had no history of systemic diseases or systemic drug treatment, and underwent scleral buckling surgery for rhegmatogenous retinal detachment. The surgical process was smooth. Results: On the third day after surgery, the patient developed retinal artery occlusion. We immediately provided emergency treatment for retinal artery occlusion, but the patient’s vision did not recover well. After several months of symptomatic treatment, the patient’s visual acuity gradually improved after surgery. Conclusions: Although the patient’s postoperative vision has improved, retinal artery occlusion can cause serious visual impairment. In order to avoid recurrent retinal artery occlusion after scleral buckling surgery, we have summarized and analyzed relevant literature reports to understand the factors related to retinal artery occlusion after scleral buckling surgery for rhegmatogenous retinal detachment and effective methods to prevent retinal artery occlusion after scleral buckling surgery. Acknowledgments This work was supported by a project grant from Xinjiang Military Region General Hospital Beijing Road Medical District Youth Cultivation Research Project: Analysis of the therapeutic effect of anti-neovascular drugs combined with low dexamethasone intravitreal implants on central retinal vein occlusion in young people (Grant No. 2022jzbj105). MHBM314: STUDY OF ANESTHETIC EFFICACY AND SAFETY OF CIPROFOL COMBINED WITH ALFENTANIL IN ERCP EXAMINATIONS Youcheng Li a , Shilong Zhang a , Linzhi Lu b , Xiwen Zhao c , Qiang Liu d , Depeng Zhang e a Anesthesiology Department, Gansu Wuwei Tumour Hospital, Wuwei, 733000, China, b Gastroenterology Department 1, Gansu Wuwei Tumour Hospital, Wuwei, 733000, China, c Traditional Chinese Medicine College, Gansu Health Vocational College, Lanzhou, 730000, China, d Gastrointestinal Surgery Department, Gansu Wuwei Tumour Hospital, Wuwei, 733000, China, e Department of Pain Treatment, Gansu Wuwei Tumour Hospital, Wuwei, 733000, China. Background: To assess the anesthetic effectiveness and safety of combining Ciprofol injection with Alfentanil in ERCP examinations. Through this investigation, we aim to provide insights into the viability and security of this anesthetic approach for enhanced patient outcomes during ERCP procedures. Subjects and Methods: 42 adult patients voluntarily enrolled for ERCP examinations were randomly divided into a control group (Propofol combined with Alfentanil group) and an experimental group (Ciprofol combined with Alfentanil group). The control group received Propofol 1.5mg/kg + Alfentanil 5ug/kg, and the experimental group received Ciprofol 0.4mg/kg + Alfentanil 5ug/kg. Heart rate (HR), mean arterial pressure (MAP), oxygen saturation (SpO 2 ), Wong-Baker Facial Expression Rating Scale pain scores were observed at 5 minutes after entering the room (T0), after anesthesia induction completion (T1), during insertion of the endoscope into the papilla (T2), and upon leaving the room (T3). General patient information and ERCP-related parameters such as sedation success rate, papillary sphincter intubation success rate, procedure time, awakening time, total drug usage, and intraoperative arrhythmia occurrence were recorded. Analyzing various data sets, a comprehensive summary of the comparative results was conducted. Results: Both the control group and the experimental group had a 100% sedation success rate and papillary sphincter intubation success rate. There were no statistically significant differences (P&gt;0.05) in HR, SpO 2 , procedure time, and intraoperative arrhythmia occurrence at different time points between the two groups. Compared to the control group, the experimental group had a relatively higher MAP ( P &lt;0.05), shorter awakening time ( P &lt;0.05), and lower drug usage ( P &lt;0.05). Conclusions: The utilization of Ciprofol in conjunction with Alfentanil in ERCP procedures demonstrates a safe and effective approach. This combination offers distinct advantages, including enhanced hemodynamic stability and expedited recovery compared to the combination of Propofol with Alfentanil. The more favorable hemodynamic profile contributes to a smoother intraoperative course. Additionally, patients administered with Ciprofol exhibit a quicker awakening time post-procedure, enhancing overall procedural efficiency. These findings underscore the potential benefits of Ciprofol and Alfentanil synergy in ERCP, supporting its consideration as a reliable alternative for achieving optimal outcomes in clinical practice.
